chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
If any of you intends to marry, then let him inquire about her hair just as he inquires about her face, for hair is one of the two aspects of beauty.

key_terms.الْجَمَالَيْنِ: the two aspects of beauty; referring to paired features of attractiveness
key_terms.شَعْرِهَا: her hair; mentioned as an aspect of beauty to inquire about
key_terms.وَجْهِهَا: her face; a visible feature commonly asked about
key_terms.يَتَزَوَّجَ: to marry; to enter into marriage

ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام advise someone to ask about when intending to marry?
ai.summary: This hadith advises a person intending marriage to make reasonable inquiry about physical appearance, mentioning hair alongside the face as an important aspect of beauty. It reflects practical guidance concerning spouse selection within the context of marriage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If any of you intends to marry, let him inquire about her hair just as he inquires about her face, for hair is one of the two aspects of beauty."
